company.shortDescription: Aura Technologies is a digital insurance technology company offering embedded insurance APIs and customized online coverage solutions.
company.description: Aura Technologies is a digital insurance technology company specializing in embedded insurance and API-driven solutions for businesses. It enables companies to integrate customized insurance products directly into their platforms, creating seamless customer experiences. Aura focuses on simplifying policy issuance, claims management, and insurance distribution through scalable technology. Its solutions support insurers, fintechs, and enterprises looking to modernize insurance operations, improve accessibility, and deliver flexible digital coverage options efficiently across multiple industries.
